project.name: osgi/pipeline
project.description: The pipeline domain: the passive fluent-pipeline grammar (pipeline-core — the topic runner, failure handler, and stage failure) plus the passive bootstrap orchestration stages (pipeline-bootstrap). Both are PASSIVE modules (pure logic, no @Component, no framework boot), so each is dual-consumable: a real OSGi bundle at build time, yet equally usable flat on the host classloader (system-exported for type resolution). They unify what used to be duplicated between seed-master (host) and manifests-core (bundle).
